```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>

#include "liter_llm.h"

int main(void) {
    const char* api_key = getenv("API_KEY");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_list_models(client);
    literllm_models_list_response_free(result);
```
